title: Biography of Pastor Ian Calo: A Journey from Troubles to Transformation
paragraphs: Biography of Pastor Ian Calo: A Journey from Troubles to Transformation

Step into the extraordinary life of Pastor Ian Calo, an inspiring figure who has experienced a remarkable transformation through his faith in God. As the outreach pastor of Don Francisco Ministries within the New Life in Christ Fellowship, Pastor Ian has dedicated his life to helping others draw nearer to God and find redemption in their own lives.

Pastor Ian's journey began with a troubled past, marked by personal struggles and a sense of aimlessness. He was once a quarrelsome husband, lost in the darkness of alcoholism, and lacking direction in life. However, everything changed when he encountered God and experienced a powerful spiritual awakening.

Through his newfound faith, Pastor Ian's life was completely transformed. The burdens of his past were lifted, and he discovered a deep sense of purpose and passion to serve God and others. Eager to make a difference, he embraced his calling as a pastor with unwavering determination.

But Pastor Ian's path was far from easy. With a burning desire to help people, he embarked on various entrepreneurial ventures to fund his ministries and support his family. He started a business delivering bottled drinking water, ensuring that everyone could quench their thirst and hydrate their bodies. Additionally, he took on the challenging task of driving a motor tricycle to provide for his loved ones and bring stability to their lives.

Pastor Ian's commitment to his faith and his community is truly remarkable. Despite the challenges he faced, he remained steadfast in his pursuit of spreading God's love and grace. With unwavering dedication, he reached out to those in need, offering support, guidance, and a listening ear to anyone who sought solace.

In his role as an outreach pastor, Pastor Ian has touched countless lives, guiding them towards a closer relationship with God. His authenticity, compassion, and personal journey of transformation have made him relatable and approachable, allowing him to connect with individuals from all walks of life.

Through his ministry work, Pastor Ian has witnessed numerous miracles and seen the transformative power of God's love in action. His profound experiences and testimonies have not only strengthened his own faith but have also inspired others to seek a deeper connection with their Creator.

Today, Pastor Ian Calo stands as a beacon of hope, a living testament to the incredible transformation that can occur when one surrenders their life to God. His story serves as a reminder that no matter how troubled one's past may be, there is always hope for redemption and a brighter future.

With his unwavering passion, entrepreneurial spirit, and deep faith, Pastor Ian continues to touch lives and make a positive impact on his community. Through his ministries, he strives to bring healing, restoration, and a renewed sense of purpose to all those he encounters.

Pastor Ian's life serves as an inspiration to us all, reminding us that with God's grace, anything is possible. His journey from a troublesome husband and a lost soul to a dedicated pastor and a vessel of God's love is a testament to the transformative power of faith and the boundless potential within each and every one of us.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Daily Devotional #70
paragraphs: Daily Devotional #70
Dear God,

As I read through Acts 2, I am reminded of the incredible power of your Holy Spirit and the transformative effect it had on your early disciples. The events of Pentecost were truly miraculous, as your Spirit descended upon your followers and empowered them to speak in tongues and boldly proclaim your message to people from all nations.

Lord, I am struck by the courage and conviction that your disciples displayed in the face of persecution and opposition. Despite the danger and uncertainty that they faced, they remained steadfast in their faith and devoted to spreading your gospel. Their example inspires me to be more faithful, more bold, and more committed to your mission in my own life.

As I reflect on Acts 2, I am also reminded of the incredible community that emerged among your followers. They were united in their devotion to you and to one another, sharing all things in common and supporting each other through both joy and hardship. Lord, help me to be more like them – to prioritize relationships and to seek out opportunities to support and encourage my fellow believers.

Finally, as I meditate on this chapter, I am reminded of the ultimate purpose of the Holy Spirit’s work – to bring people into relationship with you. Through the preaching of Peter and the testimony of your disciples, many came to faith and were baptized, joining the community of believers and receiving the forgiveness and salvation that only you can offer. Lord, I pray that I too would be a witness to your love and grace, and that through my words and actions, others would come to know you and experience the life-changing power of your Spirit.
Thank you for the incredible example of faith and community that we see in Acts 2. May it inspire and challenge me to be a more faithful follower of you each and every day.
In Jesus’ name, Amen.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Daily Devotional #68
paragraphs: Daily Devotional #68
Dear God,

As I read Luke 24, I am reminded of the profound truth of your resurrection. Just as the women who went to the tomb on the first day of the week found it empty and encountered angels who proclaimed that you had risen, so too do I believe in your triumph over death.

It's incredible to think that the very same Jesus who died on the cross and was buried in a tomb is the very same Jesus who is alive and victorious today. It's a reminder that death is not the end, but merely a transition to a new and eternal life with you.

As I reflect on this chapter, I am struck by the reactions of the disciples when they first heard the news of your resurrection. They were initially filled with doubt and disbelief, but as they encountered you in the flesh and saw the scars on your hands and feet, their doubt turned to joy and amazement.

Lord, I pray that my own doubts and fears would be replaced by faith and trust in you. Help me to believe in your resurrection not just as a historical fact, but as a present reality that has the power to transform my life.
May the truth of your resurrection fill me with hope and joy, knowing that nothing is impossible for you and that you are always with me, even in the darkest moments of my life.
Thank you for the gift of your Son and the victory over death that he has won for us. May I always live in the light of his resurrection, and may my life be a reflection of his love and grace.
In Jesus' name I pray, Amen.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Daily Devotional #67
paragraphs: Daily Devotional #67
Dear God,

As I read Luke 23, I am reminded of the incredible sacrifice that you made for us through the crucifixion of your son, Jesus Christ. It is a powerful reminder of the depth of your love and the lengths to which you are willing to go to save us.

The chapter opens with the trial of Jesus before Pilate. I can only imagine how difficult this must have been for Jesus, knowing that he was innocent but still facing false accusations and the prospect of a horrific death. Yet, he remained steadfast and resolute, refusing to defend himself or compromise his message.

The scene then shifts to the journey to the cross, with Jesus being mocked, beaten, and forced to carry his own cross. Again, the incredible love and sacrifice of Jesus is evident here. He endured all of this pain and suffering for us, willingly taking on the punishment that we deserved.

As I reflect on these events, I am humbled by the depth of your love for us. It is a love that goes beyond human understanding and is demonstrated so powerfully in the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Help me to never take this sacrifice for granted and to live my life in a way that honors your gift.

Thank you for your incredible love and for the sacrifice that you made for me. May I never forget the incredible depth of your love and may I always strive to live my life in a way that brings honor and glory to your name.
Amen.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Daily Devotional #69
paragraphs: Daily Devotional #69
Dear God,

As I read through Acts 1, I am struck by the unity and dedication of the disciples in the aftermath of your ascension. They were committed to carrying out your mission, even though they must have felt overwhelmed and uncertain about what the future held.
Lord, I want to have that same sense of purpose and dedication in my own life. I want to be focused on your will for me and to be willing to take risks and step out of my comfort zone to serve you.

At the same time, I am reminded that I cannot do it alone. The disciples were not left to figure things out on their own, but were empowered by your Holy Spirit. Lord, I pray that you would fill me with your Spirit and give me the courage and wisdom I need to follow you wholeheartedly.
Help me to trust in your plan for my life, even when it may not be clear to me. And may I always remember that my ultimate goal is to glorify you in all that I do.
Thank you for your grace and your love, and for the example of the disciples in Acts 1. May I strive to follow in their footsteps as I seek to serve you.
In Jesus' name, amen.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Pastor Rey Sanico is a dynamic and inspiring leader who is deeply committed to mobilizing God's people for the harvest of souls. He has a passion for teaching and leading God's people, and is dedicated to equipping and mobilizing the body of Christ to be actively involved in the Great Commission. As a result of his efforts, many have been awakened, aligned, and assigned to their kingdom assignments.
paragraphs: Pastor Rey Sanico is a dynamic and inspiring leader who is deeply committed to mobilizing God's people for the harvest of souls. He has a passion for teaching and leading God's people, and is dedicated to equipping and mobilizing the body of Christ to be actively involved in the Great Commission. As a result of his efforts, many have been awakened, aligned, and assigned to their kingdom assignments.

With his enigmatic personality, Pastor Rey has the ability to introduce people to the word of God and to enhance their knowledge of the Bible. He is a very anointed and charismatic leader who has pushed many to become not only better Christians, but also better people in their communities. His infectious smile and constant activity show that he has not slowed down in his pursuit of God's work.

Together with his wife, Pastora Cecile Sanico, Pastor Rey is dedicated to serving the Lord and the body of Christ. Their partnership is a testament to the power of unity and to the importance of strong relationships in the ministry.
Overall, Pastor Rey is a true example of an engaging leader who is dedicated to empowering and equipping others to become effective and impactful Christians in their communities.

In real life, life is like that, but the most important is what you do when no one cares and no one knows. God will always see your heart and that is worth more than a billion praises from anyone else... always be humble my friends and let God be your always purpose in life, to make God happy in everything you do.
